title: They work.
date: Reviewed in the United States on March 17, 2026
review: One of these has been installed in my pool cabana for about 2 months now, where I saw at least one gnat strafing me. Since there are now a few dozen gnats and a mosquito stuck inside, I’m gonna say these work as advertised. Now I just have to figure out how they’re getting in.I put the second one in my bedroom. We’ve never seen any flying insects in there, but I wanted to see if it would make a good ‘night light.’ The light is soft but does light up the room enough to see. I’m very ‘light-sensitive’ and like a dark room, but this hasn’t bothered me at night at all.I’m happy with these and would recommend them to family and friends.Hope this helps.

title: Not so good for house flies
date: Reviewed in the United States on October 29, 2025
review: I can't give these an awful review because they are catcxhing bugs, just not the kind that I want. I have had them plugged in for over 4-5 days now and have caught plenty of gnats/fruit fly size bugs. My issue is that our home has been inundated with house flies. These traps haven't caught a single house fly and trust me, there have been PLENTY to catch.Bottom line: smaller bugs that are more attracted to blue lights will get caught with these. House flies, though? I'm not sure I would waste my money on this product to try to get house flies.This is just my experience, but I wanted to share!

title: Not an instant solution like sprays but far safer for pets and they do work given a couple days.
date: Reviewed in the United States on August 6, 2025
review: We found one of my kids had left a food bag with some scraps that had basically rotted and now we had a huge infestation of those little gnats, fruit flies, or similar little bugs around. we have 2 cats and dog and I'm hesitant to use sprays, even those that say they're "pet friendly".  I decided to give the a shot and although the results haven't been instantaneous, after a couple of days, there has been a marked decline in the number of flying bugs.I went with this particular product because it was a 2 pack with a bunch of refill sticky pads. I set one up in two different rooms where the infestation was the worst.  They could not be any easier to use. you peel the plastic covering off the sticky pads and insert them in devices and plug them in.  They have blue light that attracts the bugs which then get caught on the sticky pads.They do seem to work best when it gets dark and there is no sunlight through the windows and lights in the room are off to compete with the devices light for the bugs attention.I would definitely purchase these again.
